case_title.quote: JASDEEP SINGH @ JASSU v. STATE OF PUNJAB
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.quote: Four accused persons were charged, convicted, and sentenced
number_of_accused.reason: Judgment states four accused were charged and convicted.

accused_gender.reason: Judgment never explicitly states the accused's gender; no pronoun or description confirms it.

accused_age.reason: No age is given for any accused in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Accused occupation is not stated in the judgment.

accused_socioeconomic_status.correct_value: Respondent's counsel alleged the accused are influential persons (argument only)
accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Judgment records counsel's submission that accused are influential, so 'Not stated' is inaccurate.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned in the judgment.

victim_gender.quote: the accused did not shoot him thereafter
victim_gender.reason: Deceased is referred to with male pronouns, and he is the father's son.

victim_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the deceased.

victim_caste.reason: Victim caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Victim religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Known to each other; accused described as friends of each other and deceased had a dispute with them
accused_victim_relationship.quote: All the accused are friends of each other.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused were known to the deceased, not strangers; the motive involved a dispute over a raid.

offence_category.correct_value: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (s.304 Part I)
offence_category.quote: the case was brought under Exception 4 to Section 300 IPC
offence_category.reason: Courts held no premeditation and convicted under s.304 Part I, not murder; murder was contested.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.304 Part I and s.34; also s.302 (sought by complainant), s.299, s.300 Exception 4 discussed
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.302, s.299 and s.300 Exception 4, which the judgment discusses.

weapon.quote: A1 took out a gun from his pocket and shot the deceased
weapon.reason: Gun is the weapon used; judgment also says A2 had a gun, which is consistent with 'Gun'.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness (PW6, PW10); medical evidence; recovery of weapons; complaint and statements
evidence_type.quote: This was also supported by the medical evidence.
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness and medical evidence are supported, but circumstantial evidence is not discussed; recoveries and statements are omitted.

confession.reason: No confession by any accused is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are recorded as found by the court.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are recorded in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: conviction has been rendered against all the accused for the offences punishable under Section 304 Part I IPC along with life sentence
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the judgment's account of trial court conviction and life sentence.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court concurred with trial court and upheld conviction under s.304 Part I
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court concurred with the views of the trial court.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court was not 'not applicable'; it upheld the trial court's conviction.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeals of A3 and A4 allowed (acquitted of s.34 liability); complainant's appeal dismissed; A1 and A2 convictions not challenged
final_outcome.quote: Crl. A. No.1584 of 2021 and Crl. A. No.1585 of 2021 are allowed. The Crl. A. No.1586 of 2021 stands dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: Acquittal applies only to A3 and A4; the complainant's appeal was dismissed, which the value omits.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s.304 Part I (against A1, not disturbed)
offence_finally_established.quote: does not suffer from any perversity
offence_finally_established.reason: The s.304 Part I finding was upheld as not perverse, so 'None' is contradicted.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Life imprisonment imposed by trial court; set aside as against A3 and A4
imprisonment_type.reason: Trial court imposed life sentence; 'none' ignores this, though it was set aside for A3 and A4.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed number of years is stated; sentence described as life.

fine_rs.reason: No fine amount is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts without stating the outcome (remove 'leading to their acquittal' and the conclusion about HC/SC findings)
neutral_facts.quote: the High Court and Supreme Court found the evidence insufficient to establish common intention for A3 and A4, leading to their acquittal
neutral_facts.reason: Facts reveal the court outcome (acquittal); also says accused were 'charged with' the lesser offence, which is loosely stated.

offence_severity.correct_value: Not stated (judgment only records a life sentence imposed by trial court)
offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state a minimum or maximum punishment range.

attempt_completion.quote: the deceased was shot dead by the accused persons
attempt_completion.reason: The offence was completed; the deceased was shot and died.

physical_harm.quote: A1 took out a gun from his pocket and shot the deceased
physical_harm.reason: Death of the deceased from gunshot is consistent with the judgment.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Not stated (one offence, s.304 Part I read with s.34, against four accused)
number_of_offences.quote: Four accused persons were charged, convicted, and sentenced
number_of_offences.reason: Judgment counts four accused, not four offences; 'three finally upheld' is not supported.

financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment records no property or financial loss; 'Not applicable' should be 'Not stated'.

premeditation_planning.quote: holding that there was no premeditation, and the occurrence took place in pursuance to a sudden fight
premeditation_planning.reason: Matches the trial court's finding accepted by the Supreme Court.

motive.correct_value: Deceased believed a raid on the family hotel was done at the accused's instance
motive.quote: the deceased felt that a raid conducted in the hotel belonging to him and his father (PW6) ... was done at the instance of the accused
motive.reason: The judgment identifies a motive; 'Not identified' is contradicted.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Trial court's no-premeditation finding not perverse; PW6's evidence not rejected but exaggerated; PW13 disbelieved; A3 and A4 convictions set aside
key_evidence_accepted.quote: Though the evidence of PW6 was not rejected, both the courts did find a clear exaggeration on his part.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Says conviction 'dismissed' (it was set aside) and calls PW6 unreliable, though the court said PW6 was not rejected.

witness_credibility.quote: Though he turned hostile despite being a friend of the deceased, the trial court did take into consideration his earlier statement
witness_credibility.reason: Assessment of PW6, PW13 and PW10 matches the judgment's findings.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct by the accused is recorded in the judgment.

custody_duration.correct_value: Not stated; A1 has since been let out on pre-mature release
custody_duration.quote: A1 has since been let out on pre-mature release by the State
custody_duration.reason: Duration not stated, but the judgment records A1's release on pre-mature release.

bail_history.reason: No bail history is mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Duration not stated; occurrence on 21.04.2011 at about 12:45 a.m.
trial_duration.quote: The occurrence took place at about 12:45 a.m. on 21.04.2011
trial_duration.reason: No trial duration is given; the listed events are accurate but do not answer the field.

legal_representation.correct_value: Names of counsel listed for appearing parties (Shekhar Naphade, Siddharth Luthra, etc.); no party assignment; Rahul Rathi, LCRA assisted
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names are correct but the judgment does not assign them to the accused or State; LCRA omitted.

investigation_status.quote: PW24 took up the investigation and completed the formalities. Recoveries have been made, including of the weapons.
investigation_status.reason: Matches the judgment's account of investigation and recoveries.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is recorded as a finding; the PW6 improvement is an evidentiary point.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court convicted; HC concurred; A1 and A2 did not appeal; A3 and A4 appeals allowed; complainant's appeal (s.302 claim) dismissed
appeal_history.quote: Thus, A1 and A2 have not filed their appeals.
appeal_history.reason: Omits that the complainant's appeal seeking s.302 was dismissed.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Complainant's counsel argued offence is under s.302, presence suffices under s.34, and accused are influential
prosecution_argument.quote: It is not necessary that an accused will have to do a physical act in order to attract Section 34 IPC. Thus, a mere presence of the accused would suffice.
prosecution_argument.reason: Instigation was PW6's version; the recorded argument is s.302 and mere presence, which the value omits.

defence_argument.correct_value: A3 and A4 argued PW13 disbelieved so s.34 misapplied, PW6 improved and presence doubtful, mere statement insufficient, A2 would have been asked to shoot
defence_argument.quote: A mere statement per se would not be sufficient to attract Section 34 IPC.
defence_argument.reason: Captures PW6 improvement and awareness of gun, but omits PW13 and the 'mere statement' and A2 arguments.

legal_principle_applied.quote: Section 34 IPC creates a deeming fiction by infusing and importing a criminal act constituting an offence committed by one, into others
legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the judgment's statement of the s.34 principle and proof requirement.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Eleven cases relied on (as listed) plus Barendra Kumar Ghosh and Shah v. Emperor referred to
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Barendra Kumar Ghosh v. King Emperor AIR 1925 PC 1; Shah v. Emperor AIR 1945 PC 148 – referred to.
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Relied-on cases are correctly listed, but the two cases only referred to are omitted.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives no sentencing rationale; 'Not applicable' should be 'Not stated'.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Judgment records no mitigating factors; 'None' asserts a finding the judgment does not make.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Judgment records no aggravating factors; 'None' asserts a finding the judgment does not make.

other_sentence_order.reason: No other sentence order is recorded in the judgment.
